THE LONG BEACH COMMUNITY
  INVESTMENT COMPANY AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, MARCH 19, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 4:00 PM

Alejandra Ramirez, Chair  Jasmine Esparza, Director
Eva Melgarejo, Vice Chair  Ruben Minjarez, Director
Hakim Chambers, Director  Elwood Sides, Director
Hilda Delgado, Director

  REVISED

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT EMAIL COMMENTS TO
  MEGGAN.SORENSEN@LONGBEACH.GOV

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-54691  Recommendation to receive and file President’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-54692  Recommendation to approve the minutes for The Long Beach Community
  Investment Company meeting of Wednesday, February 19, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-54693  Recommendation to authorize the President or designee to negotiate and enter
  into a Disposition and Development Agreement for the conveyance of 1131
  East Wardlow Road to West Hollywood Community Housing Corporation;

  Approve a loan in the amount of $5,649,032.10 to West Hollywood Community
  Housing Corporation to provide acquisition funding for the future development of
  1131 East Wardlow Road; and

  Authorize the President or designee to execute any and all documents necessary
  to implement the Disposition and Development and Loan Agreements.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address The Long Beach Community Investment Company on non-agenda items.
Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Vanessa Hall, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact (562) 570-3807 or (562) 570-6957.

CALL TO ORDER

At 4:01 PM, Chair Ramirez called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present: Delgado, Esparza, Minjarez, Sides, Ramirez

  Commissioners Absent: Chambers, Melgarejo

Also present: Christopher Koontz, President, Meggan Sorensen, Vice President, Adam Jacobs,
Deputy City Attorney, Vanessa Hall, City Clerk Specialist.

Chair Ramirez spoke; and announced that Vice Chair Melgarejo and Director Chambers were
excused from the meeting.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

Director Sides led the Pledge of Allegiance.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-54691  Recommendation to receive and file President’s Report.

  A motion was made by Chair Ramirez, seconded by Director Minjarez, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  5  Delgado, Esparza, Minjarez, Sides, Ramirez
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 2  Chambers, Melgarejo

  Meggan Sorensen, Vice President, spoke; and provided the President’s Report.

  Director Esparza joined the meeting.
